payload.title: Ship Limatus Python SDK API for programmatic callers
payload.description:
Public Python module API: load style config, diagnose(draft), propose_options(findings, decisions), apply helpers. Suitable for Papyrus and Tactus procedures. Same core as CLI — not a CLI wrapper.
